reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and existing bank/import helpers, but Fintegra copies provider workflows and takeover duplicates the existing local unlink operation.

duplication.why: The change adds three substantial duplicated blocks: the account-link lifecycle, the transaction downloader, and the local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Provider handlers, downloads, configuration and models follow existing module boundaries, although an assertion-named helper now also performs account mutations.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the four requested linking and provider changes, their test coverage and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking rules help maintenance, but copied provider workflows and hidden unlink mutations inside the guard create multiple responsibilities and parallel implementations to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked directly repeats unlinkAccount's local field reset; extracting a shared local detach operation would preserve takeover's required avoidance of remote cleanup.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra handler, downloader and unlink reset are straightforward copies rather than duplication obscured through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: accounts/app.ts: the shared guard gains replaceExistingLink and six conditional branches covering target validation, conflicts and replacement, expands from assertion to mutation, and duplicates unlinkAccount's local detach at one call site.
